title: Include RBAC v2 authz decision fields in exports + SIEM mappings (backward compatible)
author: Kevin Osei
release_notes: Exporter now emits RBAC v2 authorization decision context fields when present (policy_version, role_ids, decision, decision_reason, resource, action, scope). Existing downstream schemas remain compatible; new fields are additive and can be toggled per sink in config.
description: Context: As part of RBAC v2 rollout, Redwood services are enriching audit events with authorization decision context (allow/deny + policy metadata). Enterprise customers want these fields in SIEM exports for troubleshooting and evidence. This PR updates audit-log-exporter to: (1) pass through + normalize new authz decision fields when present, (2) update default field mappings for common SIEM targets (Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs, Azure Sentinel/Log Analytics), and (3) preserve backward compatibility for older event payloads that do not include authz decision context. Summary of changes: Add an optional authz_decision block to the internal normalized event model (all fields nullable); Update sink mappers to emit flattened keys by default (e.g., authz.decision, authz.policy_version, authz.role_ids) while keeping existing top-level keys unchanged; Add a compatibility shim that detects legacy field names used by early control-plane builds (authzDecision vs authz_decision) and normalizes them; Ensure exporter does not drop events when role_ids is large (cap list length in export with truncation marker, configurable); Add golden tests for each sink with both old-style events (no authz) and new-style events; Add docs for config flags: export_authz_fields (default true) and authz_role_ids_max (default 50). Validation: End-to-end ran against staging sample payloads from control-plane (post PR redwood#18522) and verified Splunk/Datadog dashboards can query allow/deny with no parsing errors. Risk: Low; changes are additive and guarded. Rollout: Safe to deploy exporter before services emit authz fields; no config change required.
commits: Normalize authz decision fields into internal event model
Update Splunk HEC mapping to include authz.* fields (additive)
Update Datadog mapping + tags for authz decision
Add Azure Sentinel mapping for new fields + schema doc
Compatibility shim for legacy authzDecision naming + null-safe parsing
Golden tests for sinks (legacy vs v2 events) + fixtures
Docs: config knobs and examples; bump exporter schema version note
review_conversation: Allison Grant: Can we guarantee we won’t emit empty authz fields for legacy events? Some SIEM parsers treat empty objects weirdly. Kevin Osei (author): Yep—mappers now only emit authz.* keys when decision is non-empty OR policy_version is present. For fully legacy events the authz namespace is absent. Added a golden test (splunk_legacy_no_authz) to lock this in. Marcus Lin: Please ensure deny reasons are stable enums (not free-form strings) and that we don’t leak internal policy expressions. Kevin Osei (author): Good call. Exporter only passes through decision_reason as the service-provided reason code (e.g., MISSING_PERMISSION, SCOPE_MISMATCH). No policy text is included. I added a small validator that drops unexpected reason strings into authz.decision_reason=UNKNOWN and copies raw to authz.decision_reason_raw only when debug_export=true. Chloe Martin: What about very large role_ids arrays? Console can assign lots of custom roles for some enterprises. Kevin Osei (author): Added authz_role_ids_max (default 50). When exceeded we export the first N and include authz.role_ids_truncated=true and authz.role_ids_total=<count>. This keeps payload size bounded. Allison Grant: Can we keep the field naming consistent across sinks? Azure sometimes needs different conventions. Kevin Osei (author): For consistency we export the same flattened keys across all sinks; Azure mapper additionally mirrors a couple fields into Sentinel-friendly columns (AuthzDecision, AuthzAction) but those are aliases; primary keys remain authz.*. Marcus Lin: Please add a note to docs that exporter can be deployed ahead of control plane emitting the fields. Kevin Osei (author): Added to each sink doc + changelog. Allison Grant: Looks good after the empty-field fix. Approved. Marcus Lin: Approved contingent on validator change landed. Kevin Osei (author): Pushed commit "Reason code validator + debug-only raw passthrough". Marcus Lin: Approved.
